directions.name: A · 暗场仪器
directions.thesis: 研究进程是一台精密仪器：一屏读完全部方向的状态与证据，键盘直达任何程序。
directions.signature: 证据刻度：每个方向把最佳记录和噪声线画在同一把刻度上，越过噪声线的一段与谱系里的最佳祖先链用同一种信号橙。

axes.typeFamily: neo-grotesk variable UI sans + plex mono figures
axes.color: graphite neutrals + one signal orange; status by glyph shape
axes.layout: three-pane app shell: nav rail, content, activity or inspector
axes.material: layered dark planes with hairline rules

directions.name: B · 研究报告
directions.thesis: 每个方向是一篇可核验的研究报告：标题句直接陈述现状，图在前，数字跟着图走。
directions.signature: 数据句标题：首页第一句话由实时数据生成，彩色下划线把“已确认”“超预算”连到下面对应的小图。

axes.typeFamily: humanist sans reading text + monospace figures and kickers
axes.color: white ground with observable-style categorical status palette
axes.layout: editorial column with small multiples and a sidenote column
axes.era: contemporary data journalism and computational notebooks
axes.material: flat paper with hairline figure rules

directions.name: C · 适应度地形
directions.thesis: 进化是在适应度地形上的勘探：每个方向是一幅图幅，程序是测点，最佳谱系是登顶路线。
directions.signature: 等值地形：只在有效得分测点覆盖的范围内插值画等高线，有效得分不足的已勘测区画成珊瑚色斜线，不借用远处得分；金色路线标出最佳程序的祖先链，空方向显示为“未勘测”图幅。

axes.typeFamily: condensed DIN-style grotesk with letter-spaced map labels
axes.color: hypsometric teal ramp + gold route + coral failures
axes.layout: full-bleed map sheets with floating legend and panels
axes.era: survey cartography and nautical charts (20th century)
axes.material: engraved print with double-rule sheet frames

decision.rationale: Owner choice 2026-10-19: A (dark instrument) as the base, absorbing three parts of B: island-lane lineage chart, progress small multiples with labelled axes, and the data-sentence headline on the home page. Default theme dark (light theme also delivered); full-site zh/en language toggle; directions and all runs as separate pages in one shell; the remaining 17 capability decisions as recommended (owner-decisions.md).
